hero.description: Grok Bot is xAI’s product for durable AI teammates. Each Bot has memory, files, and browser sessions that survive between turns. Bots sign into real apps, collaborate with each other, and interrupt you mainly for approvals. Pair that with Grok frontier models on the API for coding and agentic tool use. TenthMatrix helps you adopt Grok Bot safely beside Claude and OpenAI agents — with clear ownership, connectors, and promotion controls.

introduction.title: What is Grok Bot?
introduction.content: Grok Bot is not a chat thread that resets. It is a roster of named AI teammates that share one account-scoped cloud computer. They use apps the way people do — browser and computer use when APIs are missing — keep durable state, and coordinate with other Bots. Skills capture how work should be done; routines decide when it runs. TenthMatrix positions Grok Bot for always-on operational lanes while Claude Code remains the deep coding agent on your repos.
keyPoints: Persistent computer: Shared cloud VM with browser, filesystem, and terminal per account
Named teammates: Durable memory, sessions, and preferences across turns
Computer use: Operate apps and sites without clean APIs when connectors alone are not enough
Skills & routines: Reusable instructions plus schedules or event-driven runs
Multi-bot coordination: Parallel Bots that message, share context, and hand off ownership

features.title: Persistent cloud computer
features.description: Every Bot runs on the same user-scoped cloud machine. Files, browser sessions, and logins persist so handoffs do not restart from zero — treat credentials as shared across your Bots.

features.title: Skills, plugins & connectors
features.description: Skills encode steps, decision rules, and safety boundaries. Plugins and connectors attach CRM, inbox, Slack, GitHub, and other systems Bots need to finish real work.

features.title: Routines & automations
features.description: Routines tell a Bot when to run — on a schedule or after supported events. Draft and reconcile first; require approval for send, purchase, delete, or production changes.

features.title: Grok API & coding models
features.description: Builders can call Grok frontier models (including Grok 4.6-class reasoning and coding) via the xAI API for custom agents, while Grok Bot covers persistent teammate workflows.

useCases.title: Outbound and CRM follow-through

useCases.title: Recurring ops packs

useCases.title: Long-running research agents

useCases.title: Companion to Claude Code

faq.question: How is Grok Bot different from Grok chat?
faq.answer: Grok chat is a conversational interface. Grok Bot is a persistent teammate product: named Bots on a shared cloud computer that keep memory, use apps, run routines, and collaborate with other Bots.

faq.question: Do Bots share credentials?
faq.answer: Yes — the cloud computer is isolated to your account, not to each Bot. Treat logins and files as available to all of your Bots, and design approvals accordingly.

faq.question: Should Grok Bot replace Claude Code?
faq.answer: Usually no. Claude Code remains the deep repository coding agent. Grok Bot shines for always-on operational and knowledge-work lanes that must continue when laptops are closed.

faq.question: What are skills and routines?
faq.answer: A skill is a reusable set of instructions for how to do a task. A routine tells a Bot when to run — on a schedule or after a supported event — with test runs and pause controls.

faq.question: How does TenthMatrix help with Grok Bot?
faq.answer: We help you design Bot roles, connector scopes, approval policies, and how Grok Bot sits beside Claude and OpenAI agents — including WSL Proxy, Vault leases, and Ring Promoter promotion where needed.
